description:
Hey, I’m Apex—and this is Apex Psychology.

For as long as I can remember, I’ve been curious about how people actually think and feel… not the textbook stuff, but the real, everyday mess.

Like, why do we overthink so much?
Why do we get attached to the wrong people?
And why do some of us just feel… different?

Why do you feel this way?
Why do others act the way they do?
And what does it all actually mean?

These are the kinds of questions that don’t usually have clear answers.

So I started this channel as a place to explore them.
To break things down—simple, real, and straight to the point.

But more than that, my goal is to help you understand yourself a little better…
to feel a little less confused, and a little less alone in the way you think and feel.

Some of you are here to understand yourself.
Some of you are trying to understand others.

Either way, I’m glad you’re here.

And yeah… I’m Apex.
See you in the next video.
